Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: dwoitzik
Message:
feat(database): replace bare postgres StatefulSet with CloudNativePG operator

CloudNativePG operator:
- CNPG 0.23.0 deployed via ArgoCD Helm Application in cnpg-system namespace
- PodMonitor enabled, Grafana dashboard auto-provisioned in monitoring namespace

CNPG Cluster for postgres-authelia:
- Replaces bare postgres:16-alpine StatefulSet with operator-managed Cluster resource
- Same 8Gi Longhorn storage, same credentials interface
- WAL archiving to Garage S3 (cnpg-garage-backup secret, 7-day retention)
- PITR (Point-in-Time Recovery) enabled via continuous WAL shipping
- PodMonitor for Prometheus scrape of cluster metrics

Authelia:
- Updated postgres address from postgres-authelia.database → postgres-authelia-rw.database
  (CNPG creates separate read-write endpoint)

Data migration (one-time, see cluster.yml for commands):
  1. pg_dump from old StatefulSet → restore into CNPG primary
  2. Delete old StatefulSet and PVC
  Merge order: cloudnative-pg operator first, then postgres-cluster Application

Message:
feat: increase k3s VM RAM + add ROADMAP.md

k3s RAM update via Terraform (Atlantis will apply on PR):
- k3s-11 master: 8GB → 12GB (balloon 4-12GB)
- k3s-12 worker: 8GB → 16GB (balloon 4-16GB)

RAM when AI LLM inference is not active.

Immich, Jellyfin, Navidrome, Home Assistant, Gitea) + hardware
(4TB SSD short-term, silent SSD NAS long-term) + RAM plan + TODOs.
